prompt: A towering elemental of living wind, a translucent humanoid figure made of swirling pale-blue vapor and white mist, its body resolving out of a churning vortex with no solid flesh, hovering high above the clouds. Streaks of fast-moving air and wisps of cloud spiral around its limbs, leaves and dust caught in the gale around it. The background is a bright cerulean sky packed with billowing white cumulus clouds.

A colossal cyclone given a face and torso, a tornado-shaped elemental of grey-white storm wind churning over a landscape, its upper body a humanoid form of spiraling vapor with two glowing pale-cerulean eyes, the funnel narrowing to a point that tears at the ground. Broken branches, dust and torn leaves whirl inside the spinning column. The background is a turbulent blue-grey sky with low racing clouds and a distant horizon.

A winged elemental beast of the sky, its body formed from layered pale-blue and white wind-currents like sculpted vapor, vast feathered wings of mist spread wide as it rides a gale, side profile facing south-west, soaring fast. Streaming air-trails curl off its wingtips. The background is a bright cerulean sky filled with towering white cumulus clouds, the same big billowing clouds as the surrounding set.

Close-up of a wind elementals face and shoulders, a fierce humanoid head sculpted entirely from swirling translucent vapor and condensation spirals, cheeks blowing a powerful gust toward the viewer, hollow glowing white eyes, hair and beard streaming back as fast-moving air. Faint debris streaks past. The background is bright cerulean sky with soft white clouds blurred by motion.

A genie-like air elemental rising from a spiraling waterspout of wind, its lower body dissolving into a thin twisting tail of vapor, muscular translucent blue-white torso and outstretched arms summoning gusts, hovering above a sea of clouds. Crepuscular rays of sunlight break through the clouds behind it. The background is a deep cerulean sky over a billowing white cloud-sea.

A serpentine elemental of pure wind, a long coiling dragon-like body made of braided white and pale-cerulean air-currents, no scales or flesh, twisting through the sky in a sinuous S-curve, mouth open trailing a vortex. Cloud wisps spiral along its length. The background is bright blue sky with large white cumulus clouds.

A powerful humanoid elemental woven from visible wind, its form outlined only by the white condensation spirals and streaking air-currents that trace its arms, chest and legs, mostly transparent so the sky shows through its body, arms thrown wide unleashing a gust, floating among clouds. Dust and feathers scatter outward from it. The background is a bright cerulean sky thick with billowing white cumulus clouds.

A muscular elemental warrior of compressed storm-air, solid-looking torso of pale blue-grey cloudstuff with white highlights along the edges where wind streaks off it, three-quarter view, fists raised, hovering aggressively. A small tornado spins where its legs should be. Leaves and grit blast outward around it. The background is a stormy blue-grey sky with fast low clouds.

An air elemental as a swirling whirlwind with a faintly humanoid upper form, glowing pale-cyan eyes peering from within the spinning vapor, full body airborne and centered, wisps of cloud trailing from its outstretched arms of wind. Birds scatter away from it. The background is a vivid cerulean sky packed with big white billowing cumulus clouds, matching the surrounding card set.
